note_build_output: The dashboard is the demonstration, not the home page. It builds to docs/demo/ and is served at demo_path; docs/index.html is the landing page built by scripts/build-landing.js. A pre-launch checkout points this at docs2B/index.html instead, outside the served tree entirely.
note_demo_path: The public route of the built dashboard. Declared rather than derived from build_output, because a pre-launch build_output names a staging path that is not served at any route at all.

postures.pre-launch: docs/ serves a data-free placeholder. The built dashboard goes to docs2B/. eval:served asserts no dataset content reaches docs/.
postures.live: docs/ serves the built dashboard. eval:served relaxes the data assertion and instead requires that a public-mode decision is recorded below.

note: public_mode "synthetic" means the served page carries invented demonstration data (see config/public-candidate.json's synthetic_dataset block) and no personal record of anyone's actual usage. Moving posture to "live" requires public_mode to be set, because going live publishes whatever docs/ contains; here it always has been synthetic.
note_default_range: The page opens on the whole record rather than the trailing year, because the synthetic rows sit in a fixed past year. Remove this key or set it to 365 for a live record.
note_links: Footer routes for the served page. Like the domain above, these name a public location, so they live here rather than in src/index.html: a build with no site config renders no footer. An agent landing on the dashboard needs a way out of it, to the source, to the contract the data obeys, and to a person.

landing.author: Sam Rogers
landing.note: Byline and identity for the landing page. Dates: date_published is the first commit of the private delegated-watch-record repository, where the work began; date_modified is the first public release of this one.
landing.note_live_example: A published real record built with this tool, linked from the home page as the worked example. The demo carries synthetic data; this one does not.
